selectionRationale: The repeated replay_010 and replay_011 missing_entity_fail_closed class points to PacketEntities index/lifecycle uncertainty, while recovery, skip, placeholders, parser fixes, default changes, and canonicalization remain unsafe and unauthorized.
wouldTryToProve: Whether compact index/lifecycle metadata at the existing missing-entity boundary can distinguish never-registered, removed, registry-loss, and index-stream-suspected cases more consistently.
Whether the existing fail-closed boundary can be enriched diagnostically without changing parser continuation, registry state, or field materialization.
Whether future intervention evidence is strong enough for a later human decision about behavior-changing work.
wouldNotTryToResolve: It would not recover missing UPDATEs.
It would not skip payloads or PacketEntities entries.
It would not create placeholder entities or synthetic registry state.
It would not continue parsing after missing entity as if the UPDATE were valid.
It would not change default behavior.
It would not generate canonical facts, source artifacts, match facts, or interpretation outputs.
